thesis: AMPL is a rich-valuation, GAAP-unprofitable software name buying into a risk-off tape where tech and growth are the lagging groups and long yields are at a 1-year high. The stock sits just under a hard resistance (18.85) that was rejected on heavy volume right after earnings, so the post-earnings gap-fade is fresh supply overhead. Volume gives no breakout confirmation, and the card itself shows reward/risk to first resistance of only about 0.7, so the 2.3 headline ratio depends on a breakout that has not happened. After a +41% 63-day run, the entry is extended and high-ATR (4.8% of price), so a regime-driven de-rating could take the stock through the 17.0 SMA20 and toward the 15.6 swing low quickly. There is no near catalyst to offset this, since earnings are not due until about February.
